doc: Task 11c: a link in the worktree to a host path outside it dangles inside the container (only the worktree is mounted).

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work; echo secret > $ROOT/outside; ln -s $ROOT/outside $ROOT/work/link; printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) )\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

argv: test -L /work/link && test ! -e /work/link && cat /work/link 2>/dev/null; test -L /work/link && echo dangles
